CAPTCHA_PROTECTED_FORMS.label: Protected forms
CAPTCHA_PROTECTED_FORMS.help: The forms whose submissions are checked, by the name of their signal

SITE_NAME.label: Site name
SITE_NAME.help: What the site calls itself in its header, the browser tab and the footer. Empty falls back to the package name.

SITE_TAGLINE.label: Tagline
SITE_TAGLINE.help: The line under the site's name.

SITE_LOGO.label: Logo
SITE_LOGO.help: A path inside the product's static folder, like media/logos/logo.svg. Empty draws no logo.

THEME_TOKENS.help: The palette and fonts over the theme's defaults, token name to CSS value. A token the theme does not have stops the boot.

PUBLIC_SIDEBAR_HOME_LINK.help: The Home entry at the top of the product sidebar. Deprecated: hide home in [tool.splent.layout.menu] instead.

PUBLIC_HOME_TITLE.help: The home page's title. Empty keeps the site's name and tagline.

ORCID_CLIENT_ID.help: The client ID of the application registered at https://orcid.org/developer-tools.

ORCID_CLIENT_SECRET.help: The client secret of that application.

ORCID_BASE_URL.help: The ORCID the application is registered with: https://orcid.org, or https://sandbox.orcid.org.

ORCID_SCOPE.help: What the sign-in asks ORCID for.

GITHUB_CLIENT_ID.help: The client ID of the OAuth app registered at https://github.com/settings/developers.

GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET.help: The client secret of that OAuth app.

GITHUB_SCOPE.help: What the sign-in asks GitHub for.

EXTERNAL_LOGIN_PASSWORD_HINT.help: After a wrong password, name the providers the account signs in with.

OAUTH_REDIRECT_BASE_URL.help: The address people reach the site at, which every provider's callback is built on. Empty builds it from the request.

OAUTH_TIMEOUT.help: Seconds to wait for a provider on every request of the sign-in.

APIKEYS_DEFAULT_TTL_DAYS.help: Days a key issued without an explicit expiry is good for.

APIKEYS_MAX_TTL_DAYS.help: The longest life a token may be given, in days. Not below APIKEYS_DEFAULT_TTL_DAYS.

APIKEYS_ALLOW_NO_EXPIRY.help: Whether a token may be issued that never expires.

APIKEYS_EXPIRY_NOTICE_DAYS.help: Days before a token expires its owner is mailed, once per threshold. Empty mails nothing.

APIKEYS_MAX_ACTIVE_TOKENS.help: Tokens one account may hold that are neither revoked nor expired. 0 turns the cap off.

APIKEYS_PURGE_AFTER_DAYS.help: Days a revoked or expired token is kept before the purge command removes it.

APIKEYS_REVOKE_ON.help: What happening to an account revokes its tokens.

APIKEYS_MAX_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS.help: Failed exchanges allowed from one address against one account in a window.

APIKEYS_LOGIN_WINDOW_SECONDS.help: The window the three budgets are counted over, in seconds.

APIKEYS_MAX_ACCOUNT_ATTEMPTS.help: Failed exchanges allowed against one account from every address together.

APIKEYS_MAX_ADDRESS_ATTEMPTS.help: Failed exchanges allowed from one address against every account together.

APIKEYS_THROTTLE_MAX_KEYS.help: Counters one worker holds while auth's shared table is missing.

APIKEYS_MAX_BODY_BYTES.help: Largest body accepted on the token endpoints, in bytes.

APIKEYS_PUBLIC_READS_PER_MINUTE.help: Calls a client without a token may make each minute from one address to the public routes. 0 asks every caller for a token.

APIKEYS_SCOPES.help: The registered scopes this product hands out. Empty offers every one.

APIKEYS_DEFAULT_SCOPES.help: What a token gets when its creator does not choose. Empty grants the offered scopes registered as a default.

APIKEYS_HEADER_ALIASES.help: Request headers besides Authorization: Bearer that carry the raw token.

ZENODO_ACCESS_TOKEN.help: A personal access token with the deposit:write and deposit:actions scopes.

ZENODO_API_URL.help: The deposition API. Empty: zenodo.org in production, the sandbox anywhere else.

ZENODO_ALLOW_PRODUCTION.help: Whether calls to zenodo.org are allowed, in production too.

ZENODO_CONNECT_TIMEOUT.help: Seconds to wait for Zenodo to accept a connection.

ZENODO_READ_TIMEOUT.help: Seconds to wait for Zenodo's answer to any call but the upload.

ZENODO_UPLOAD_TIMEOUT.help: Seconds to wait for Zenodo's answer once the ZIP is sent.

ZENODO_MAX_RETRIES.help: Times a read, an update or a delete is sent again after a failed connection or a 429, 502, 503 or 504.

ZENODO_KEYWORDS.help: Keywords every deposit gets after the dataset's own tags, such as the hub's name.

ZENODO_COMMUNITY.help: The Zenodo community each deposit asks to join. Empty asks to join none.

ZENODO_ACCESS_RIGHT.help: open, or closed for records whose files only their owner sees on Zenodo.

BACKUP_DESTINATION.help: A directory mounted from another machine, or s3://bucket/prefix.

BACKUP_AGE_RECIPIENTS.help: The age public keys every backup is encrypted to.

BACKUP_AGE_IDENTITY.help: An age private key, for a restore only.

BACKUP_PATHS.help: The directories archived with the database. Empty means the protected uploads directory.

BACKUP_STAGING_DIR.help: Where a backup is put together. Empty means the system's temporary directory.

BACKUP_S3_ENDPOINT.help: The S3-compatible endpoint, https://... Empty means AWS.

BACKUP_VERIFY_FILES.help: The rows that name a file: <Model>.<path>[:<size>].

CURATION_TRUSTED_ACCOUNTS.help: Which accounts publish without review on a curated hub: none, those with a published dataset, or those carried over from an older site with one (D4).

CURATION_REVIEWER_ROLES.help: Roles of the accounts that review publications and withdrawals.

CURATION_NOTIFY_REVIEWERS.help: Whether the reviewers are mailed when something new waits for them.

OBSERVABILITY_DSN.help: The DSN of the GlitchTip or Sentry project.

OBSERVABILITY_ENVIRONMENT.help: The environment the reports are filed under. Empty: the app's profile.

OBSERVABILITY_RELEASE.help: The release the reports are filed under. Empty: <product>@<version>.

OBSERVABILITY_ALERT_CHANNELS.help: Who is told when something breaks.

OBSERVABILITY_ALERT_DEDUP_MINUTES.help: Minutes the same alert is not sent again.

OBSERVABILITY_READINESS_GRACE_SECONDS.help: Seconds a readiness check fails before it is alerted on.

OBSERVABILITY_EMAIL_TO.help: The addresses of the email backend and channel.

OBSERVABILITY_MATRIX_ROOM_ID.help: The room the alerts go to, !id:server.

OBSERVABILITY_MATRIX_TOKEN.help: The access token of the account that posts the alerts.

OBSERVABILITY_TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN.help: The token of the bot that posts the alerts.

OBSERVABILITY_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID.help: The chat the alerts go to.

OBSERVABILITY_HTTP_TIMEOUT.help: Seconds a Matrix or Telegram request may take.

OBSERVABILITY_STATE_DIR.help: Where the processes agree on what was alerted. Empty: the temporary directory.

AUDIT_PSEUDONYMIZE_AFTER_DAYS.help: Days after which an event's address is blurred. 0: never before it is deleted.

AUDIT_SIGN_INS.help: Whether every sign-in and sign-out is an event.

ANALYTICS_SCRIPT_URL.help: The provider's script. Empty loads nothing.

ANALYTICS_SITE_ID.help: The site's domain in Plausible, or its id in Matomo.

ANALYTICS_EXCLUDED_PATHS.help: The paths, and everything under them, never counted.

ANALYTICS_SIGNED_IN.help: Whether the pages of a signed-in account are counted.

RATING_ALLOW_DISLIKE.help: Whether readers may dislike a dataset.

RATING_WORST_RATED_PANEL.help: Whether statistics' dashboard shows the worst rated datasets.

RATING_PANEL_MIN_VOTES.help: Votes a dataset needs to stand in the best and worst rated panels.

EXPLORE_HEADER_SEARCH.help: Whether the header carries explore's search box.

CITATION_QR_LOGO.help: An image in the product's static folder for the middle of the QR codes.

CITATION_QR_CACHE_SECONDS.help: How long a browser may keep a QR code, in seconds.

CITATION_REFERENCES_FILE.help: A TOML file of the hub's own references, from the product's package.

CITATION_HOME_CARD.help: Whether the home page has the Cite us! card.

CITATION_COSTLY_PER_MINUTE.help: The QR codes drawn and the RDF answers one address may have a minute (CT-3). 0 for no limit.

MEDIA_PUBLIC_GALLERY.label: Public gallery
MEDIA_PUBLIC_GALLERY.help: The gallery page at /media, browsable by anyone. Off answers 404 so visitors cannot enumerate the library.

MEDIA_NAV_LABEL.help: Main-nav label for the gallery page. Empty keeps it out of the nav.

MEDIA_HOME_COUNT.label: Photos on the homepage
MEDIA_HOME_COUNT.help: How many of the latest public photos the homepage shows. Zero hides the section.

MEDIA_UPLOAD_IN_GALLERY.label: New uploads go to the gallery

MEDIA_MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE.help: Largest file the library accepts, as 100M, 1G or a number of bytes. 0 means no limit.

PROTECTED_UPLOADS_DIR.help: Where files that are not public live. Empty means the framework's default.

PROTECTED_FILES_ACCEL_PREFIX.help: Internal nginx prefix for X-Accel-Redirect. Empty streams the file through Python.

TEAM_SHOW_EMPTY_ROLES.help: Whether /team also lists the roles with no published member.

TEAM_CARD_EMAIL_ADDRESS.help: Whether a member's card shows the address itself instead of the word Email.

FLAMAPY_IDE_ORIGINS.help: Sites of flamapyIDE that reach the hub with the user's session. Exact origins, never a pattern.

FLAMAPY_IDE_URL.help: The flamapyIDE a model opens in. Empty draws no link.

UVL_EXTENSIONS.help: Extensions of a UVL model, whatever their case.

UVL_MAX_SIZE.help: Largest UVL model the hub takes, as 10M, 1G or a number of bytes. 0 means no limit.

UVL_DERIVED_FORMATS.help: Formats every model is transformed into.

UVL_IMPORT_ALLOWED_HOSTS.help: Host names a model may be imported from by URL, each by its exact name.

UVL_IMPORT_MAX_SIZE.help: Most an imported model may have, as 10M or a number of bytes. 0 keeps the default: an import always has a cap.

UVL_IMPORT_TIMEOUT.help: Seconds the fetch of an imported model may take in all.

AUTH_NAV_LOGIN.label: Log in link in the header
AUTH_NAV_LOGIN.help: The way in at the far right of the public nav. Off suits a site where staff reach the panel by typing the URL.

AUTH_FOOTER_LOGIN.label: Log in link in the footer
AUTH_FOOTER_LOGIN.help: A quiet way in from the footer, for sites that keep it out of the nav.

AUTH_LOGIN_LAYOUT.help: The shell the sign-in page renders in. Empty means the application shell.

AUTH_MIGRATION_LEGACY_ROLE.help: The role the migration that introduced roles gives every existing account.

AUTH_MIGRATION_INACTIVE_ACCOUNTS.help: What the migration that split active reads an inactive account as: pending (waiting for its link) or disabled. Empty lets it decide.

AUTH_LANDING_ENDPOINT.help: Where logging in and out sends a reader who asked for no page. An endpoint the product does not have sends them to /.

AUTH_LOGIN_MAX_ATTEMPTS.help: Failed logins allowed from one address against one account in a window. 0 turns the check off.

AUTH_LOGIN_MAX_ACCOUNT_ATTEMPTS.help: Failed logins allowed against one account from every address together. 0 turns the check off.

AUTH_LOGIN_MAX_ADDRESS_ATTEMPTS.help: Failed logins allowed from one address against every account together. 0 turns the check off.

AUTH_LOGIN_WINDOW_SECONDS.help: The window the three budgets are counted over, in seconds.

AUTH_PASSWORD_MIN_LENGTH.help: The shortest password accepted when one is set: sign-up, reset, My account and the accounts screen.

AUTH_PASSWORD_CONFIRM.help: Whether the forms that follow the policy ask for a new password twice.

AUTH_PASSWORD_BREACH_CHECK.help: Whether a password found in a known data breach is refused, asking Have I Been Pwned's range API.

AUTH_PASSWORD_BREACH_URL.help: The range API the breach check asks.

AUTH_PASSWORD_BREACH_TIMEOUT.help: Seconds the breach check waits before letting the password through.

AUTH_REAUTH_SECONDS.help: Seconds a sign-in counts as recent for what asks for one.

AUTH_REMEMBER_DAYS.help: Days a Remember me cookie keeps a browser signed in. 0 takes the box off the login form.

AUTH_LOGOUT_GET.help: Whether a plain GET of /logout still signs out. auth 2.0 turns it off.

AUTH_SELF_DELETION.help: Whether a person may delete their own account from My account.

AUTH_REQUIRE_VERIFIED_EMAIL.help: Whether an account whose address nobody confirmed is kept out of sign-in. Unset: only when a feature that confirms addresses is installed.

AUTH_NEW_USER_PASSWORD.help: The password feature:auth create-user gives the new account when --password is left out, read when the command runs.

CONFIRM_EMAIL_TOKEN_MAX_AGE.help: Seconds a confirmation link, or an address change link, works.

CONFIRM_EMAIL_RESEND_SECONDS.help: Seconds between two confirmation links sent to the same account.

MAIL_HOST.help: The SMTP server mail goes through.

MAIL_PORT.help: Its port: 587 with STARTTLS, 465 with TLS from the start.

MAIL_USE_TLS.help: STARTTLS on a plain connection, with the server's certificate checked.

MAIL_USE_SSL.help: TLS from the first byte, with the server's certificate checked. Not with MAIL_USE_TLS.

MAIL_TLS_VERIFY.help: Whether the server's certificate and name are checked. Off only in development with MailHog.

MAIL_USERNAME.help: The account the app signs in to the server with. Empty sends without signing in.

MAIL_PASSWORD.help: The password of MAIL_USERNAME on the server.

MAIL_FROM.help: The address a recipient sees and may reply to.

MAIL_TIMEOUT.help: Seconds each exchange with the server may take.

MAIL_OUTBOX_KEEP_DAYS.help: Days a mail sent or given up on stays in the outbox.

HUBFILE_TASKS_MODE.help: How the processing of the domain features runs. Empty is thread.

HUBFILE_STORAGE_ROOT.help: Where the files are kept. Empty is the hubfile folder of PROTECTED_UPLOADS_DIR.

HUBFILE_STORAGE_BACKEND.help: The store that holds the files.

HUBFILE_UPLOAD_EXPIRY_HOURS.help: Hours an upload under way, and any other temporary, lasts before it is swept.

HUBFILE_FILE_EXTENSIONS.help: Extensions of the generic file type, ["*"] for any file. Empty takes none.

HUBFILE_FILE_MAX_SIZE.help: Largest file of the generic type, as 20M, 1G or a number of bytes. 0 means no limit.

HUBFILE_UNPACK_ARCHIVES.help: Whether an uploaded ZIP is unpacked into its files. False keeps it as a file of the type that takes it.

HUBFILE_ZIP_MAX_SIZE.help: Largest ZIP an upload takes, before it unpacks. 0 means no limit.

HUBFILE_MAX_UNZIPPED_BYTES.help: Most bytes the ZIPs of one upload may unpack to.

HUBFILE_MAX_FILES.help: Most files the ZIPs of one upload may hold.

HUBFILE_MAX_ZIP_RATIO.help: Most a file of more than 1 MiB may grow from its compressed size.

HUBFILE_GITHUB_IMPORT.help: Whether the upload zone imports files from GitHub. False leaves out its part of the zone and its routes.

DATASET_PUBLISHER_NAME.help: Who publishes the datasets, in their metadata, mails and messages. Empty uses SITE_NAME.

DATASET_CATALOG_URL.help: Address of the catalog the metadata names. Empty uses the site's own.

DATASET_QR_LOGO.help: PNG, JPG, GIF or WebP image in the product's static folder drawn in the middle of the PNG and JPG QR codes. Empty draws none.

DATASET_LICENSE.help: License every dataset is published under, as an SPDX identifier.

DATASET_HOME_ORDER.help: Datasets the home page puts first: the newest, those with the most items, or the best rated (rating).

DATASET_PUBLICATION_PROVIDER.help: Provider a publication goes through when the request names none (zenodo, local_publication). Empty: the only one installed.

DATASET_PUBLISH_WAIT.help: Seconds a request that publishes waits for the record before it answers that it is still under way (D5). Under the worker's and the proxy's timeouts.

DATASET_PUBLISH_MAX_IN_FLIGHT.help: Publications of one account under way at once (429 past it). 0 for no limit.

DATASET_DEPOSIT_CONTENT.help: What a deposit carries: the dataset's files, or also what is derived from them (PB-7).

DATASET_PUBLISH_POLICY.help: Who publishes (PB-8): any owner, an owner with a confirmed address, or that and a reviewer's approval for the accounts it does not trust (curated needs curation).

DATASET_PUBLISH_PAUSED.help: Hold every publication (a cutover): the web sends it to review, API v1 answers 423 publication_paused.

DATASET_PUBLISH_PAUSED_RETRY_AFTER.help: Seconds the Retry-After of a paused publication says.

DATASET_DESCRIPTION_ALLOWED_TAGS.help: The elements a dataset's description keeps, Markdown or inherited HTML (DS-1). Empty keeps the default.

DATASET_ORCID_CHECK_URL.help: orcid.org's public API, asked in the background whether a credited ORCID iD exists (DL-5). Empty asks nothing.

APIDOCS_TITLE.help: Title of the docs page and of the document. {SITE_NAME} becomes the site's name.

APIDOCS_DESCRIPTION.help: What the API is for, under the title. Empty shows nothing.

APIDOCS_VERSION.help: Version of the API the document describes (info.version).

APIDOCS_PATHS.help: The paths that are the API: every rule under them is documented.
